出現|chūxiàn: 通常第一名只有一位，但有時也會出現例外的情況。

Usually there is only one first place, but sometimes there are exceptions.
大事|dàshì: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。

Commemorative stamps generally use major historical events or important figures as their themes.
完成|wánchéng: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。

家人|jiārén: 我每個星期天早上都跟家人去教堂。

寄|jì: 我要到郵局去寄信，也要買一些信封。

I want to go to the post office to mail a letter, and also buy some envelopes.
對話|duìhuà: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。

During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over.

的|de: (used after a noun, verb or adjective to form a nominal expression, as in 皮革的 (pí gé de) "one made of leather" or 跑堂兒的 (pǎo táng r de) "a waiter (literally, one who runs back and forth in a restaurant)" or 新的 (xīn de) "new one")

Yes, I would like to buy a pair of black ones.
組|zǔ: measure word for sets, series, groups of people, batteries
同事搬新家，我們送他一組茶具，恭喜他吧。

起飛|qǐfēi: (of an aircraft or rocket) to take off; to lift off

Nǐ de fēijī shénme shíhou qǐfēi?
What time does your plane leave?

A: Nín hǎo, huānyíng nín lái miànshì. Qǐngwèn guì xìng? B: Nín hǎo, wǒ xìng Tóng, hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng dào guì gōngsī lái miànshì.
